meta.title: RI Workplace | Office Design and Build, New York and New Jersey
meta.description: RI Workplace designs, builds and furnishes offices across New York and New Jersey. One family-run team from first sketch to move-in day. 35 years, 475+ projects.

hero.eyebrow: OFFICE DESIGN-BUILD · NEW YORK + NEW JERSEY · SINCE 1991
hero.h1: Thriving workplaces designed, built and delivered fast.
hero.sub: One family-run team takes your office from first sketch to move-in day. You never get passed between a designer and a contractor.

numbers.label: of our business comes from referrals

work.line: Every space on this page is a finished RI project.

steps.line: Design and construction sit under one roof at RI. That is why our projects finish up to 30% faster than the architect-plus-contractor route.

items.name: Dream
items.copy: We start with a working session on your goals and your budget. The project is about you.

items.name: Design
items.copy: Our designers and architects turn that into a space that looks like your company. You see it in 3D before anything gets built.

items.name: Build
items.copy: Our own project managers run construction, with weekly check-ins and a budget tracked as we go.

items.name: Transform
items.copy: Furniture and finishes go in. Your team moves into an office they want to come back to.

body: The story starts in the trades in the 1970s. In 1991 Rob Scott opened Renotech Interiors in a converted house in Valley Stream, New York.
Thirty-five years and two name changes later, the Scotts still run the company, now in its third generation.

showroom.body: Our Saddle Brook office doubles as the showroom. Walk the space and pull samples from the library. Coffee is on us.
